x: The handicap was won by our new member, C. MacLennon, who walked well to finish in 42-20, and with 7 minutes allowance he beat Percy Wilson by 5 secs., with W.

I am indebted to Jack Goswell, Alf Harley, Bob Taylor, Dave Sheppard, Bill Lucas, Charlie MacLennon, Alan Mead, Howard Satchell, to the general committee, and in particular to Chris Steer, Bernard Merry, Arthur Penstone and our indefatiguable barmen Frank Webb, Norman Dewberry and Tom Pritchard.
The road to Brighton was positively crowded with Belgrave supporters with Ray Hall and Charlie MacLennon exhausting themselves pushing the Bels on.

Doug Fotheringham 45:13 with 8:10 allowance won the Handicap and Barry Ingarfield, a new signing from Ipswich, 45:59 with 8:40 allowance took third. Charlie MacLennon, handicapped by a number of pints, finished - just! in 55:59 But on the same Day at Morecambe things were going better.
